title: Hospital Write-Off of Denied Amounts — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Retired clause.** "A denied amount is written off by the hospital, never billed to the patient, when its route ends in a write-off: timely filing expired (no timely-filing proof), no authorization obtained (no authorization, notification, emergency exemption or retro authorization), non-covered with no waiver (no advance waiver on file), appeals exhausted (the last available level upheld the denial), or below the appeal threshold (a denied amount at or below the small-denial write-off amount that is not worth appealing)." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current write-off basis for the Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing).

**Clauses in force**
1. A denied amount above the payer class's small-denial write-off amount is never written off as below the appeal threshold while an appeal window remains open.
2. The same denial reason is written off once per write-off reason on a claim.
3. A write-off never reduces the patient's own liability posted from other remittance lines.

**Duplicate check as the records show it.** Before a write-off entry is booked, the claim's activity is read for write-off entries; an entry with the same denial reason code and the same write-off reason already on that claim means that combination has been written off.

| Existing write-off on the claim | New write-off with the same reason code | Allowed |
|---|---|---|
| none | any write-off reason | yes |
| same reason code, write-off reason A | write-off reason A | no |
| same reason code, write-off reason A | write-off reason B | yes |

Example (hypothetical): with an appeal window still open, a denied amount of 300.00 on a payer class whose small-denial amount is 50.00 is not written off as below the appeal threshold.

superseded_clauses: A denied amount is written off by the hospital, never billed to the patient, when its route ends in a write-off: TIMELY_FILING_EXPIRED (no timely-filing proof), NO_AUTHORIZATION_OBTAINED (no authorization, notification, emergency exemption or retro authorization), NONCOVERED_NO_WAIVER (no advance waiver on file), APPEALS_EXHAUSTED (the last available level upheld the denial), or BELOW_APPEAL_THRESHOLD (a denied amount at or below small_denial_write_off_usd that is not worth appealing).
